# Results tables (generated by scripts/make_results_tables.py — do not edit by hand)
Output: docs/results_tables.md (every number in docs/results_story.md comes from this file).
Definitions: missed % = released true defects / true defects; released % = released false calls / false calls;
a period = consecutive data with >= 299 true defects; "worst missed" = maximum over all periods and all seeds;
"released" = released false calls / false calls over the whole run, mean of the seeds.
A setting PASSES if worst missed <= 1 %. Among passing settings the highest released share wins.

## P6 improvement attempts (development half) and second evaluation (test half, run once)

### P6-1 Improvement ideas on the development half (day-by-day simulation, 5 seeds each)

Periods pooled from daily records (finer than the 14-day windows of P4, so the frozen model shows 2.30 % here). burst xK: extra retraining next morning if today's labelled true defects ≥ K × mean of the last 14 production days and ≥ 20. same-day switch N: no release for the rest of the day after N operator-confirmed true defects. cap 30: at most 30 threshold-set true defects per day. spc day-total qQ: no release while today's AOI calls exceed the Q quantile of the previous 14 production days. Sources: results/p6_dev_ideas.json, p6_dev_ideas2.json, p6_dev_spc.json
